title: RenderConfig
description: A task's render.json (kind: generic_template). Only `files` is checked here; nsw-srilanka reads the rest. See nsw-srilanka's docs/WORKFLOW_GUIDE.md, "File fields".

files.description: The paths in the task's data that hold stored files. The backend hands their values out only as file references. Each path is listed once.

items.description: Names joined by '.', each optionally followed by '[*]' to step into every element of a list.
